SOURCE: banner library, acetyl-hexapeptide-8-serum--J-body-and-face-right nbp_pro_01, native 6336x2688, worked at 848 high (1999x848, 2.36:1).

EXTENDED RIGHT, AND THE MEASUREMENT DECIDED THAT. Her shoulder fills 50% of the LEFT edge - skin from row 426 to the bottom - and its top line is essentially level at 0.07px down per px travelled left, so it never leaves frame. Extending that side would have meant inventing ~1700px of horizontal arm, which this project already recorded as reading like a smeared arm. The RIGHT edge is clean backdrop top to bottom at mean 24.6, so the room was made there.

Everything mirrors as a result: the heading goes centre-RIGHT over the extension, and object-position anchors LEFT so horizontal cropping only ever removes extension - never her face or the bottle, which sits at x 1500-1850 of 1999.

3750x848 (4.42:1), past the 4.36:1 the 100vw x 440px box reaches at a 1920 viewport.

A BUG THIS FRAME EXPOSED. The first build tiled mirrored ghosts of the bottle and an eye across the extension. Cause: every x in a banner config is measured on the ORIGINAL frame, but extend_left receives the MIRRORED frame for a right-side extension, so 'cols 0-700' sampled the bottle and hand instead of the clean top-left backdrop. main() now mirrors those x ranges automatically, so configs stay in the orientation a person actually looks at. The brightening-glow box was restated in the same convention and rebuilt identically.

Texture sampled from the only clean rectangle on this frame: rows 0-350 across cols 0-700, max 37 against a backdrop of ~30. Every larger box tried is contaminated - (0,500,0,500) hits max 208.
